facts.label: Passado e past progressive
facts.sub: Use o passado simples para ações terminadas e was/were + -ing para ações em andamento: I was painting when the bell rang. What did you paint?

facts.label: Passado simples
facts.sub: Para ações terminadas, use o passado: I painted a clock. I started last week. Os verbos regulares ganham -ed. Nas perguntas, use did e o verbo básico: What did you paint?

facts.label: Estava fazendo
facts.sub: Para uma ação em andamento, use was/were + -ing: I was painting. They were using glue. Com I, he, she e it, use was. Com you, we e they, use were.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Painted is the past of paint.
When can join two actions in the past.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Painted is the past of paint. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I was paint”. → Falso (We say I was painting.)
When can join two actions in the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
